title.en: Diplomatic and Consular Relations (World Meteorological Organization) Order 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Diplomatic and Consular Relations (World Meteorological Organization) Order 2018.

heading.en: Additional immunities and privileges of WMO
Immunities and privileges of representatives, etc., of member of WMO
Additional immunities and privileges of Director of Regional Office

text.en: 5. In addition to the immunities and privileges under the WMO Order, the Director of the Regional Office enjoys the like immunities and privileges that are accorded under Articles 29 to 33, 35, 36(2) and 39 of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations to a diplomatic agent.

heading.en: Additional privileges of officers of Regional Office

text.en:
7. The WMO may waive any immunity mentioned in paragraph 5 or 6 in any case where the WMO is of the opinion that —
(a)the immunity will impede the course of justice; and
(b)the immunity can be waived without prejudice to the interests of the WMO.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges do not apply to citizen or permanent resident of Singapore

text.en: 8. Paragraphs 4, 5 and 6 do not apply to any citizen or permanent resident of Singapore.
